title: Inverse Modified Scattering for Cubic NLS with a Repulsive Delta Potential
summary: We study the one-dimensional cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation with a repulsive delta potential and a localized inhomogeneous coefficient. We prove small-data modified scattering and construct the associated vector-valued modified scattering map, whose two components encode the coupling of the frequencies $ξ$ and $-ξ$ induced by the point interaction. We show that this map determines both the strength of the delta potential and the inhomogeneous coefficient.
